# SynSight

> SynSight is a German cybersecurity and OSINT platform that analyzes public digital traces, profile signals, and leak indicators — and explains risks in plain language.

SynSight is not a hacking tool. It focuses on publicly available information and permitted APIs.

## Core facts

- Product: Cybersecurity / identity intelligence platform
- Website: https://synsight.de
- Language: German (de)
- Contact: hello@synsight.de
- Privacy: datenschutz@synsight.de

## Primary tools

- [Google-Analyse](https://synsight.de/google-analyse): Public search exposure analysis
- [Username-Suche](https://synsight.de/username-suche): Cross-platform alias discovery
- [Digital Footprint](https://synsight.de/digital-footprint): Combined public exposure picture
- [Reverse Image Search](https://synsight.de/reverse-image-search): Public image reuse detection
- [E-Mail-Check](https://synsight.de/email-check): Public account / leak signals for email
- [Telefon-Check](https://synsight.de/telefon-check): Public phone metadata / OSINT signals
- [Social-Media-Analyse](https://synsight.de/social-media-analyse): Public social profile correlation
- [OSINT-Analyse](https://synsight.de/osint-analyse): Open-source intelligence overview
- [Personensuche](https://synsight.de/personensuche): Public person-related signals
- [Datenleck prüfen](https://synsight.de/datenleck-pruefen): Breach / leak exposure checks
